title: Introduce lag-compensating provision oracle and burst diagnostic exporter
author: Priya Nandakumar
description: Adds a Lag-Compensating Provision Oracle (LCPO) to reduce SLA violations caused by autoscaler headroom lag and introduces a burst diagnostic exporter that correlates utilization spikes with latency signals to help ops tune conservative headroom and soft-burst policies. Motivation: incidents in January showed short-duration microbursts that the existing warm-pool/autoscaler paths reacted to too slowly, creating transient latency spikes for dedicated tenants. LCPO uses short-horizon demand extrapolation, weighted recent-util deltas, and a lightweight speculative allocate path to create ephemeral buffer credits that bridge the autoscaler ramp-up window. The exporter emits compact correlation events (burst_event_id, tenant, pool, util_before, util_after, latency_p50/p95, decision_reason) to the telemetry pipeline for offline debugging and live dashboards. This PR contains controller logic, config knobs (speculative_credit_limit, compensation_decay_ms, signal_weighting), unit and integration tests, a performance test harness for end-to-end microburst replay, and docs for rollout and observability. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-3982) [x] unit tests [x] integration e2e harness [x] load/perf test [x] telemetry schema and Grafana dashboard prototype [x] upgrade-safe migration notes. Rollout plan: staged canary to 5% pools with feature flag; monitor burst_diagnostic.events and latency regressions for 3 days; increase to 25% then general availability if no regressions. Backout: disable feature flag and revoke speculative credits; rollback is safe because core autoscaler path unchanged. Risk: speculative credits can increase short-term GPU usage; mitigated by global speculative_credit_limit and tenant-level caps. Notes: this does not change billing semantics, credits are accounted in telemetry for future billing policy work.

review_comments: Ethan Morales: Nice design and tests. Two concerns: (1) global speculative_credit_limit feels permissive — can we add a circuit-breaker that prevents speculative credits if cluster-wide GPU utilization > 85%? (2) add more comments on how credits affect actual slot allocation to avoid confusion in the allocator code.

Priya Nandakumar: Addressed both: added a circuit-breaker check in ledger.go (threshold default 85%) and added docstrings + README section describing how speculative credits map to allocation reservations. Updated tests to exercise high-cluster-util rejection.
Liang Chen: telemetry schema looks good but please include an enum for decision_reason and make burst_event_id deterministic (hash of tenant+window) for easier debugging across services.
Priya Nandakumar: Switched decision_reason to an enum and made burst_event_id a truncated SHA256 digest; added mapping doc to mappings.yaml and updated exporter tests.
Marisol Ortega: Integration perf run looks fine, but watch memory use in ledger when many tenants create ephemeral credits concurrently. Suggested a bounded LRU cache for stale entries.
Priya Nandakumar: Implemented bounded LRU with eviction after 1h idle; added metrics lcpo_ledger_entries and lcpo_evictions_total.

CI Bot: go vet and linters passed. Perf job (microburst_replay) completed: p95 latency improved by 12% for replayed bursts, speculative credit usage averaged 3.2% of dedicated capacity during 30s spike windows.
Release Manager: Approved for canary under feature flag; include rollout checklist in release notes.
release_notes: Introduce LCPO (Lag-Compensating Provision Oracle) that can provide short-lived speculative buffer credits to reduce transient latency during microbursts. Adds burst diagnostic exporter for correlating utilization spikes with latency signals. Rollout behind feature flag. See docs/ops/lcpo-rollout.md for canary steps and operational playbook.
notes_for_ops: Feature is gated by feature flag feature.lcpo.enabled and additional knobs speculative_credit_limit (global), tenant_speculative_limit, compensation_decay_ms. Monitor metrics: lcpo_credits_allocated_total, lcpo_credits_rejected_total, lcpo_evictions_total, burstdiag_events_emitted, and existing latency SLO metrics. Backout by turning off the feature flag and clearing ephemeral credits via admin API.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover ledger accounting and extrapolator heuristics. Integration e2e harness replays recorded microburst traces against a canary cluster to validate latency wins and speculative credit safety. Perf job executed across 3 pool topologies; results in PR show median p95 latency reduction and <4% average extra capacity during spikes.
post_merge_tasks: (1) Deploy telemetry mapping to staging ingest cluster (2) Add burstdiag events to dashboards and alert rules (3) Run 72-hour canary on 5% pools and collect LCPO metrics (4) Iterate on default compensation_decay_ms if eviction/oscillation observed
